scenario_title_zh: 样衣确认与工艺成本谈判

rounds.ai_message: Hi Mark, this is Helen from Portland Trading. We are looking for a vintage-style T-shirt supplier for our SS26 line. How can I help?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 嗨 Mark，我是波特兰贸易的 Helen。我们正在找复古风 T 恤供应商做 26 春夏款。请问有什么可以帮您？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 介绍工厂能力与主打产品
rounds.common_mistakes: 工厂介绍要简洁，先讲品类和产能。
rounds.tips_zh: 首次邮件/电话介绍工厂：品类、月产能、起订量、主市场。
rounds.user_response_example: Hi Helen, this is Mark from Hangzhou Lily Garments. We specialize in vintage and garment-dyed T-shirts, capacity 80,000 pieces per month.

rounds.ai_message: Good. We need a basic crew-neck T-shirt with a vintage hand feel. Fabric is 100% cotton, 200 GSM, garment dyed. Can you do that?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。我们需要一款基础圆领 T 恤，复古手感。面料 100% 棉，200 克重，成衣染。可以做吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: GSM 不要写成 gsm 错误拼写；200 GSM 是常见 T 恤克重。
rounds.tips_zh: 200 GSM 是中厚 T 恤；180 GSM 是轻薄；230 GSM 是厚磅。
rounds.user_response_example: 200 GSM is in our sweet spot. Garment dye is our specialty — we use reactive dye and silicone softener for the vintage hand feel.

rounds.ai_message: Great. About colors — we want 6 vintage shades: faded navy, sun-faded olive, vintage red, off-white, sand and charcoal. Any concerns with color matching on garment dye?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。颜色——我们要 6 个复古色：褪色藏青、晒褪橄榄绿、复古红、米白、沙色和炭灰色。成衣染色匹配有问题吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明成衣染色的色光控制
rounds.common_mistakes: 成衣染色批次间有 ±5% 色差是行业常识，要提前告知。
rounds.tips_zh: garment dye 批次间色差 ±5% 属正常；客户需接受或加严。
rounds.user_response_example: 6 colors is fine. Garment dye has about ±5% shade variation between lots — please approve this tolerance up front, or we can move to piece dye for tighter control.

rounds.ai_message: OK, ±5% on garment dye is acceptable. What about printing on top of the garment dye — do you want a print, an embroidery, or both?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的，±5% 可接受。成衣染后要做印花还是绣花？还是都要？
rounds.common_mistakes: 印花 + 绣花成本叠加，且会影响水洗牢度。
rounds.tips_zh: 印花 + 绣花组合常见于复古款，但要先确认水洗牢度叠加。
rounds.user_response_example: Front chest print (water-based) plus small embroidery on the left sleeve. Both should survive enzyme wash.

rounds.ai_message: Water-based print and small embroidery both work on garment-dyed fabric. For the print, please send the artwork in AI or PDF. What is your timeline for the proto sample?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 水浆印花和小绣花都能在成衣染布上做。印花请发 AI 或 PDF 文件。初版样衣时间表是什么？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明样衣时间与文件准备
rounds.common_mistakes: proto sample 7-10 天是行业标准；文件格式用 AI + PDF。
rounds.tips_zh: proto sample（初版样）通常 7-10 天，含快递 3-5 天。
rounds.user_response_example: Proto sample in 10 days is fine. Artwork is ready — I will email both PDF and AI files today.

rounds.ai_message: Great. About cost — for 1,000 pieces per color, 6 colors, 6,000 pieces total, our FOB price is around US$4.80 per piece including print and embroidery. Can you work with that?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。价格——每色 1,000 件共 6 色 6,000 件，FOB 每件约 4.8 美元含印花和绣花。可以吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: 不要一上来就报最低价；要看订单规模和重复可能性。
rounds.tips_zh: vintage T 恤 FOB 4.5-5.5 美元是常见区间；6,000 件是中等订单。
rounds.user_response_example: For 6,000 pieces, can you do US$4.50 per piece? We expect repeat orders every season.

rounds.ai_message: I can come down to US$4.60 per piece for 6,000 pieces, but not lower. Embroidery digitizing is US$25 per design, refundable on bulk. OK?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 6,000 件可以做到每件 4.6 美元，但不能再低。绣花打版每图 25 美元，大货可冲抵。可以吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: digitizing fee（打版费）大货冲抵是行业标准。
rounds.tips_zh: 打版费 25-50 美元/图是大货冲抵惯例；首次合作多预付。
rounds.user_response_example: Digitizing fee of US$25 is fine. Refundable on bulk is appreciated. We will pay up front.

rounds.ai_message: OK. I will send the PI today. Lead time 35 days after PP sample approval, including garment dye and enzyme wash. Looking forward to working with you.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。我今天发 PI。批 PP 样后 35 天交期，含成衣染和酵素水洗。期待合作。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认 PI 与收件邮箱
rounds.common_mistakes: PP sample 批核后才启动大货；不要跳过 PP。
rounds.tips_zh: PP sample 批准后才开裁大货；跳 PP 易导致批量返工。
rounds.user_response_example: PI received, thank you. 35 days lead time after PP approval is fine. Looking forward to the proto sample.

rounds.ai_message: Mark, Helen from Portland Trading. We have a vintage T-shirt tech pack ready for our SS26 capsule. Before you quote, can I send over the spec sheet and Pantone TCX for your review?
rounds.ai_message_zh: Mark，我是波特兰贸易 Helen。我们 26 春夏胶囊系列的复古 T 恤工艺单已好。报价前我把规格表和潘通 TCX 发你审核，可以吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: spec sheet 接收后要内部技术评审再报价，不要口头随便承诺。
rounds.tips_zh: spec sheet 评审 24-48 小时；含工艺难点识别与产能评估。
rounds.user_response_example: Please send the spec sheet and Pantone TCX. We will review internally and quote within 48 hours.

rounds.ai_message: Spec sheet sent. The T-shirt is 200 GSM, 26/1 ring spun cotton, garment dyed with vintage wash, water-based chest print 12 cm wide, and small sleeve embroidery 4 cm. 6 colors, 1,000 pcs per color.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 规格已发。T 恤 200 克，26/1 环锭纺棉，成衣染复古水洗，前胸水浆印花宽 12 厘米，袖口小绣花 4 厘米。6 色每色 1,000 件。
rounds.common_mistakes: 26/1 ring spun 与 32s combed 不同规格，要分清。
rounds.tips_zh: 26/1 是较粗的环锭纺单纱；200 GSM 适合中厚复古 T。
rounds.user_response_example: All specs received. For 6,000 pcs total, FOB Ningbo is US$4.85 per piece. Lead time 35 days after PP sample approval.

rounds.ai_message: Good price. About the print — water-based ink on garment-dyed fabric has a softer hand feel but lower wash fastness than plastisol. We suggest a discharge print instead for the vintage look. OK to switch?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 价格合理。关于印花——水浆在成衣染布上手感更软但水洗牢度不如胶浆。建议改拔染印花以获得复古感。可以改吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: discharge print（拔染）适合深色底，水浆适合浅色底。
rounds.tips_zh: 拔染印花在成衣染深底色上效果最佳；浅色底用水浆更经济。
rounds.user_response_example: Discharge print is fine for the darker shades. For off-white and sand, water-based is enough. We can split per color.

rounds.ai_message: Per-color print method is OK. Now about the embroidery — sleeve embroidery 4 cm wide, what's the design — text, logo, or graphic?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 按色选印花可以。关于绣花——袖口 4 厘米绣花，是文字、logo 还是图案？
rounds.common_mistakes: satin stitch 用于小尺寸文字；fill stitch 用于大图案。
rounds.tips_zh: satin stitch 用于 5 毫米以下的细线文字；fill stitch 用于大块面。
rounds.user_response_example: It's our brand text logo. Satin stitch is preferred. About 5,000 stitches per piece.

rounds.ai_message: Got it. About the enzyme wash — what hand feel target do you want — soft and drapy, dry and crisp, or somewhere in between?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。关于酵素水洗——目标手感是什么？柔软垂坠、干爽挺括，还是中间？
rounds.common_mistakes: enzyme wash 时间与手感直接相关；30 分钟 = 软，60 分钟 = 非常软。
rounds.tips_zh: enzyme wash 时间越长越柔软；硅油柔软剂可补强滑感。
rounds.user_response_example: Soft and drapy is the target. Please use a silicone softener after enzyme wash for that buttery hand feel.

rounds.ai_message: OK. About the proto sample — for 6 colors × 2 sizes (M and L) = 12 pieces, sample cost is US$15 per piece plus DHL freight. PP sample (3 pcs per color) will be US$8 per piece after proto approval. OK?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。初版样——6 色 × 2 码（M 和 L）= 12 件，样衣费每件 15 美元加 DHL 运费。PP 样（每色 3 件）批核后每件 8 美元。可以吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: proto sample 成本高，PP sample 接近大货成本，结构合理。
rounds.tips_zh: proto（首版）成本高，PP（量产前样）接近大货成本，是行业标准结构。
rounds.user_response_example: Proto sample US$15 is OK. PP sample US$8 is fair. Please deduct the proto cost from the bulk PO when confirmed.

rounds.ai_message: About bulk — 6,000 pieces total. The 1,000 pcs per color allows us to run all 6 colors in one continuous dye lot, which minimizes shade variation. But I need a single PO, not split POs.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 关于大货——6,000 件总。每色 1,000 件可一缸连续染，色差最小。但需要一张 PO，不要拆单。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在拆单与合并之间选择
rounds.common_mistakes: 拆 PO 会让染厂分缸，色差风险增加。
rounds.tips_zh: 一缸染可保证 6,000 件同色光；拆 PO 必然分缸。
rounds.user_response_example: Single PO is fine. One PO with two deliveries (3,000 + 3,000) is acceptable if it helps your capacity. Please confirm in the PI.

rounds.ai_message: OK — single PO, two deliveries 30 days apart. PI will be issued today with: 6,000 pcs FOB Ningbo US$4.85, per-color print method, satin stitch embroidery, enzyme wash + silicone softener, proto US$15, PP US$8, lead time 35 days after PP approval. Please counter-sign within 3 days.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好——单 PO，两批间隔 30 天交。今天发 PI：6,000 件 FOB 宁波每件 4.85 美元，按色印花，缎面绣花，酵素水洗 + 硅油柔软，初版样 15 美元，PP 样 8 美元，批 PP 后 35 天交期。请 3 天内回签。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认 PI 与回签时限
rounds.common_mistakes: 回签前要核对所有条款：单价、印花、绣花、洗水、样衣费、交期。
rounds.tips_zh: PI 回签前用 red-line 对照内部 spec sheet，避免漏项。
rounds.user_response_example: PI received. I will red-line against our tech pack and counter-sign within 3 days. Deposit will be wired by Friday.

rounds.ai_message: Mark, Helen from Portland Trading. We are launching a vintage capsule with the band 'Cascade Reign' — 6 styles, 4 colors each, total 24,000 pieces. We need a serious partner who can handle the print, embroidery and enzyme wash with consistent vintage feel.
rounds.ai_message_zh: Mark，我是波特兰贸易 Helen。我们要为 'Cascade Reign' 乐队推复古胶囊系列——6 款每款 4 色共 24,000 件。需要能稳定做印花、绣花和酵素水洗的靠谱伙伴。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 介绍工厂能力并提出产能与认证要求
key_phrases: we can handle 30,000 pcs per month
rounds.common_mistakes: 大单首次合作要亮明资质：OEKO-TEX、BSCI、产能。
rounds.tips_zh: 欧美大客户看资质：OEKO-TEX 100、BSCI/SEDEX、SA8000 是基础门槛。
rounds.user_response_example: We can handle 30,000 pieces per month with consistent vintage wash. We are OEKO-TEX Standard 100 certified and BSCI audited with an A rating.

rounds.ai_message: Good. The capsule includes a tie-dye style. Tie-dye has a 10% shade deviation between pieces even within the same color. Can you guarantee a workable shade band, or should we move to a more controlled effect like mineral wash?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。胶囊系列含扎染款。扎染同色件与件之间有 10% 色差。你们能保证合理色光区间，还是改用更可控的矿石水洗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在扎染与矿石水洗之间选
rounds.common_mistakes: tie-dye 每件都不同；客户要接受或换工艺。
rounds.tips_zh: tie-dye 不可 100% 控制每件一致；矿石水洗更可控但效果不同。
rounds.user_response_example: For the capsule we want tie-dye authenticity, so we accept the 10% shade deviation. Please pre-produce 3 reference samples for each color to lock the band.

rounds.ai_message: OK — 3 reference samples per color for tie-dye. About cost — this is a 24,000-piece order with multiple craft processes. Our FOB price is US$5.40 per piece. Can your MD approve that for a band capsule?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好——扎染每色 3 个参考样。价格——这单 24,000 件多工艺。FOB 每件 5.4 美元。乐队胶囊款你方总经理能批这个价吗？
key_phrases: price is on the high side
rounds.common_mistakes: 大单一上来就报最低价是行业禁忌；要给出量价交换。
rounds.tips_zh: vintage + tie-dye + multi-craft 通常每件 5-6 美元；量价交换是议价核心。
rounds.user_response_example: For 24,000 pieces, US$5.40 is on the high side. Our ceiling is US$5.10. We commit to a repeat order of similar volume next season if we hit margin.

rounds.ai_message: US$5.10 is workable if you commit to a 20,000-piece repeat within 6 months. Can your MD sign a side letter on that?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 5.10 美元可行，但需要 6 个月内 20,000 件翻单承诺。你方总经理能签一份意向函吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在翻单承诺与降价之间选择
rounds.common_mistakes: 翻单承诺是议价筹码，但要量力而行；不要为降价承诺做不到的量。
rounds.tips_zh: 翻单意向函是常见议价工具，但要内部评估销售可能性。
rounds.user_response_example: We can sign a non-binding repeat intent for 15,000 pieces within 6 months, contingent on the capsule selling through. That's the realistic commitment.

rounds.ai_message: OK — 15,000-piece repeat intent, non-binding. Now quality — last year we had a print registration issue on a similar capsule, 0.5 mm off. This time we need print registration within 0.2 mm. Can you hold that?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好——15,000 件翻单意向，非约束。质量——去年类似胶囊款印花套色偏 0.5 毫米。这次要求套色 0.2 毫米以内。能做到吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: 套色公差 0.2 毫米是高标准；需要专门的定位装置。
rounds.tips_zh: 印花套色 ≤ 0.2 mm 是高档品牌标准；需精密定位装置。
rounds.user_response_example: 0.2 mm print registration is achievable with our new pneumatic screen frame. Please confirm in writing as part of the PI quality clauses.

rounds.ai_message: Confirmed in PI. About testing — your tech pack calls for 5 wash cycles for color fastness. We suggest AATCC 135 (home wash) at 30°C. Will that satisfy your buyer?
rounds.ai_message_zh: PI 中确认。测试——你工艺单要求 5 次水洗色牢度。我方建议 AATCC 135 家庭洗法 30°C。能满足你客户吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: AATCC 135（美标家庭洗）与 ISO 6330（欧标家庭洗）方法不同，要选对。
rounds.tips_zh: 美国市场多要求 AATCC 135；欧盟多用 ISO 6330。
rounds.user_response_example: Our buyer requires AATCC 135 method. Please run all wash tests on AATCC 135 at 30°C and attach the report with each shipment.

rounds.ai_message: AATCC 135 confirmed. Final terms: 24,000 pcs at US$5.10 per piece FOB Ningbo, single PO with 3 monthly deliveries of 8,000 pcs each, 30% TT deposit, repeat intent letter for 15,000 pcs. I will issue the PI today with all craft specs.
rounds.ai_message_zh: AATCC 135 确认。最终条款：24,000 件每件 5.10 美元 FOB 宁波，单 PO 分 3 批各 8,000 件月交，TT 30% 定金，15,000 件翻单意向函。我今天发 PI 含所有工艺规格。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认 PI 与回签时限
rounds.common_mistakes: 大单 PI 要总经理审批；3-5 天审批时间是合理的。
rounds.tips_zh: 大单 PI 通常需要总经理审批；预留 3-5 天审批时间。
rounds.user_response_example: 3 monthly deliveries is workable. PI received. We need 4 working days for our MD's approval given the volume. Will counter-sign by Friday.

rounds.ai_message: 4 days approval is fine — please confirm by Friday. About the capsule launch — we would like to co-brand a hangtag with your factory name and our brand. Is that OK?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 4 天审批可以——请周五前确认。关于胶囊系列——我们想用你厂名和我品牌联合吊牌。可以吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在联名吊牌与单独吊牌之间选择
rounds.common_mistakes: 联名吊牌要看 OEM/ODM 协议；ODM 多可联名。
rounds.tips_zh: 联名吊牌对 ODM 合作常见；纯 OEM 通常只用买方品牌。
rounds.user_response_example: Co-branded hangtag is fine for the ODM pieces. For the OEM pieces, single brand only. Please split the hangtag spec by piece in the PI.
